selection.text:
Our model is also much more compact relative to previous approaches.

Given a short text in a language, the model predicts the language's orthographic rules.

Therefore, a data-driven sequence-to-sequence model is a natural choice.

The model consists of two main parts: the encoder compresses each source grapheme sequence INLINEFORM0 into a fixed-length vector.

Training Multilingual Models

they built adapted models.

Because many of these languages had no training data at all, the model is actually only trained on data in 157 languages.

Full results

High Resource Results	Having shown that our model exceeds the performance of the wFST-adaptation approach, we next compare it to the baseline models for just high resource languages.

In contrast to the larger-scale Adapted results, in the High Resource experiments none of the sequence-to-sequence approaches equal the performance of the wFST model in WER and PER, although LangID-High does come close.

it does present a more compact one: LangID-High is 15.4 MB, while the combined wFST high resource models are 197.5 MB.

A more promising way forward is to find a model that uses an externally constructed typological representation of the language.
